question.en: Between which latitudes does the mainland of India extend from South to North?
question.hi: भारत की मुख्य भूमि दक्षिण से उत्तर की ओर किन अक्षांशों के मध्य विस्तृत है?
question.hinglish: Between which latitudes does the mainland of India extend from South to North?

explanation.en: According to the Survey of India, the mainland of India extends between latitudes 8°4'N and 37°6'N, and longitudes 68°7'E and 97°25'E.
explanation.hi: सर्वे ऑफ इंडिया के अनुसार, भारत की मुख्य भूमि 8°4' उत्तरी अक्षांश से 37°6' उत्तरी अक्षांश तथा 68°7' पूर्वी देशांतर से 97°25' पूर्वी देशांतर के मध्य विस्तृत है।

question.en: Emperor Krishnadeva Raya of the Vijayanagara Empire authored the celebrated epic poem 'Amuktamalyada' in which classical language?

question.en: Under Article 279A of the Indian Constitution, what weighted voting share do the Central Government and State Governments possess in the GST Council respectively?
question.hi: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 279A के अनुसार जीएसटी परिषद (GST Council) में केंद्र सरकार और राज्य सरकारों का मतदान भार (Voting Weightage) क्रमशः कितना निर्धारित है?
question.hinglish: Under Article 279A of the Indian Constitution, what weighted voting share do the Central Government and State Governments possess in the GST Council respectively?

options.en: Central Government: One-third (1/3); State Governments: Two-thirds (2/3)
options.hi: केंद्र सरकार: एक-तिहाई (1/3); राज्य सरकारें: दो-तिहाई (2/3)
options.hinglish: Central Government: One-third (1/3); State Governments: Two-thirds (2/3)

options.en: Central Government: One-half (1/2); State Governments: One-half (1/2)
options.hi: केंद्र सरकार: आधा (1/2); राज्य सरकारें: आधा (1/2)

options.en: Central Government: Two-thirds (2/3); State Governments: One-third (1/3)
options.hi: केंद्र सरकार: दो-तिहाई (2/3); राज्य सरकारें: एक-तिहाई (1/3)

explanation.en: In the GST Council, the vote of the Central Government has a weightage of one-third of total votes cast, and the votes of all State Governments taken together have a weightage of two-thirds.
explanation.hi: जीएसटी परिषद में केंद्र सरकार का मत-भार कुल मतों का 1/3 होता है और सभी राज्यों का संयुक्त मत-भार 2/3 होता है। किसी भी प्रस्ताव को पारित होने के लिए 75% (3/4) बहुमत चाहिए होता है।
explanation.hinglish: In the GST Council, the vote of the Central Government has a weightage of one-third of total votes cast, and the votes of all State Governments taken together have a weightage of two-thirds.

detailedExplanation.en: In the GST Council, the vote of the Central Government has a weightage of one-third of total votes cast, and the votes of all State Governments taken together have a weightage of two-thirds. Key takeaway: GST Council voting = Centre 1/3rd, States 2/3rd (75% to pass).
detailedExplanation.hi: जीएसटी परिषद में केंद्र सरकार का मत-भार कुल मतों का 1/3 होता है और सभी राज्यों का संयुक्त मत-भार 2/3 होता है। किसी भी प्रस्ताव को पारित होने के लिए 75% (3/4) बहुमत चाहिए होता है। मुख्य बिंदु: जीएसटी परिषद मतदान = केंद्र 1/3, राज्य 2/3 (पास होने के लिए 75%)।
detailedExplanation.hinglish: In the GST Council, the vote of the Central Government has a weightage of one-third of total votes cast, and the votes of all State Governments taken together have a weightage of two-thirds. Key takeaway: GST Council voting = Centre 1/3rd, States 2/3rd (75% to pass).

question.en: What combined public Debt-to-GDP ratio (for Centre and States combined) was recommended as the target by the N.K. Singh FRBM Review Committee in 2017?
question.hi: 2017 में एन.के. सिंह की अध्यक्षता वाली एफआरबीएम (FRBM) समीक्षा समिति ने केंद्र और राज्यों के लिए संयुक्त रूप से कितने प्रतिशत ऋण-जीडीपी अनुपात (Debt-to-GDP ratio) का लक्ष्य सुझाया था?
question.hinglish: What combined public Debt-to-GDP ratio (for Centre and States combined) was recommended as the target by the N.K. Singh FRBM Review Committee in 2017?

question.en: Remittances sent home by non-resident Indian citizens working abroad are categorized under which component of India's Balance of Payments (BoP)?

question.hinglish: Remittances sent home by non-resident Indian citizens working abroad are categorized under which component of India's Balance of Payments (BoP)?

question.en: The upper semi-molten layer of the Earth's mantle, located between roughly 100 km and 400 km depth upon which tectonic plates float, is known as the:
question.hi: पृथ्वी के मेंटल का लगभग 100 से 400 किमी की गहराई में स्थित वह अर्ध-पिघला (प्लास्टिक) स्तर क्या कहलाता है, जिस पर विवर्तनिक प्लेटें तैरती हैं?
question.hinglish: The upper semi-molten layer of the Earth's mantle, located between roughly 100 km and 400 km depth upon which tectonic plates float, is known as the:

explanation.en: The Asthenosphere (from Greek asthenes, meaning weak) is the ductile, mechanically weak zone of the upper mantle on which the rigid lithospheric plates glide.
explanation.hi: दुर्बलता मंडल (Asthenosphere) ऊपरी मेंटल का अत्यधिक तप्त एवं प्लास्टिक जैसा कमजोर भाग है; इसी के ऊपर पृथ्वी की दृढ़ स्थलमंडलीय प्लेटें गतिशील रहती हैं।
explanation.hinglish: The Asthenosphere (from Greek asthenes, meaning weak) is the ductile, mechanically weak zone of the upper mantle on which the rigid lithospheric plates glide.

detailedExplanation.en: The Asthenosphere (from Greek asthenes, meaning weak) is the ductile, mechanically weak zone of the upper mantle on which the rigid lithospheric plates glide. Key takeaway: Weak semi-molten mantle layer = Asthenosphere.

question.en: Which seismic discontinuity marks the sharp transitional boundary separating the Earth's crust from the underlying mantle?
question.hi: पृथ्वी की भूपर्पटी (Crust) और उसके नीचे स्थित मेंटल (Mantle) को एक-दूसरे से अलग करने वाली भूगर्भिक असंबद्धता कौन सी है?
question.hinglish: Which seismic discontinuity marks the sharp transitional boundary separating the Earth's crust from the underlying mantle?

explanation.en: Discovered by Croatian seismologist Andrija Mohorovicic in 1909, the Moho discontinuity separates the crust from the mantle where seismic P-wave velocity jumps abruptly.
explanation.hi: मोहोरोविसिक (मोहो) असंबद्धता क्रस्ट और मेंटल के बीच स्थित है; यहां घनत्व में अचानक वृद्धि होने से भूकंपीय तरंगों की गति अचानक बढ़ जाती है।
explanation.hinglish: Discovered by Croatian seismologist Andrija Mohorovicic in 1909, the Moho discontinuity separates the crust from the mantle where seismic P-wave velocity jumps abruptly.

detailedExplanation.en: Discovered by Croatian seismologist Andrija Mohorovicic in 1909, the Moho discontinuity separates the crust from the mantle where seismic P-wave velocity jumps abruptly. Key takeaway: Crust-Mantle boundary = Moho Discontinuity.
detailedExplanation.hi: मोहोरोविसिक (मोहो) असंबद्धता क्रस्ट और मेंटल के बीच स्थित है; यहां घनत्व में अचानक वृद्धि होने से भूकंपीय तरंगों की गति अचानक बढ़ जाती है। मुख्य बिंदु: क्रस्ट और मेंटल की सीमा = मोहो असंबद्धता।
detailedExplanation.hinglish: Discovered by Croatian seismologist Andrija Mohorovicic in 1909, the Moho discontinuity separates the crust from the mantle where seismic P-wave velocity jumps abruptly. Key takeaway: Crust-Mantle boundary = Moho Discontinuity.

question.en: According to Alfred Wegener's Continental Drift Theory, the ancient southern supercontinent formed after the initial split of Pangaea was named:
question.hi: अल्फ्रेड वेगनर के महाद्वीपीय विस्थापन सिद्धांत के अनुसार पेंजिया के आरंभिक विखंडन के पश्चात बने दक्षिणी विशाल भूभाग को क्या नाम दिया गया था?
question.hinglish: According to Alfred Wegener's Continental Drift Theory, the ancient southern supercontinent formed after the initial split of Pangaea was named:

explanation.en: Pangaea fractured into Laurasia (North America, Europe, Asia) in the north and Gondwanaland (South America, Africa, Peninsular India, Australia, Antarctica) in the south.
explanation.hi: पेंजिया के दो टुकड़े हुए: उत्तरी भाग लौरेशिया (अंगारालैंड) कहलाया और दक्षिणी भाग गोंडवानालैंड कहलाया, जिसमें भारत, अफ्रीका, दक्षिण अमेरिका, ऑस्ट्रेलिया और अंटार्कटिका शामिल थे।
explanation.hinglish: Pangaea fractured into Laurasia (North America, Europe, Asia) in the north and Gondwanaland (South America, Africa, Peninsular India, Australia, Antarctica) in the south.

question.en: The towering Himalayan mountain range was formed by which type of plate tectonic boundary interaction?
question.hi: हिमालय पर्वत श्रृंखला का निर्माण किस प्रकार की विवर्तनिक प्लेट सीमा (Plate Tectonic Boundary) की परस्पर क्रिया के फलस्वरूप हुआ है?
question.hinglish: The towering Himalayan mountain range was formed by which type of plate tectonic boundary interaction?

explanation.en: The Himalayas were formed by the continent-continent collision between the Indian Plate and the Eurasian Plate, thrusting the sediments of the Tethys geosyncline into massive fold mountains.
explanation.hi: हिमालय का निर्माण भारतीय प्लेट और यूरेशियाई प्लेट के अभिसरण (आमने-सामने की टक्कर) से हुआ, जिससे टेथिस सागर के अवसाद ऊपर उठकर मोड़दार पर्वत बन गए।
explanation.hinglish: The Himalayas were formed by the continent-continent collision between the Indian Plate and the Eurasian Plate, thrusting the sediments of the Tethys geosyncline into massive fold mountains.

question.en: According to Ferrel's Law, wind and moving objects are deflected in which direction in the Northern Hemisphere due to the Earth's rotation (Coriolis Effect)?
question.hi: फेरेल के नियम और कोरिऑलिस प्रभाव के अनुसार पृथ्वी के घूर्णन के कारण उत्तरी गोलार्ध में गतिमान पवनें किस दिशा में विक्षेपित (मुड़) जाती हैं?
question.hinglish: According to Ferrel's Law, wind and moving objects are deflected in which direction in the Northern Hemisphere due to the Earth's rotation (Coriolis Effect)?

explanation.en: Ferrel's Law states that Coriolis force deflects any moving fluid to the right of its path in the Northern Hemisphere, and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere.
explanation.hi: फेरेल के नियम के अनुसार कोरिऑलिस बल के प्रभाव से उत्तरी गोलार्ध में बहने वाली सभी हवाएं अपनी गति की दिशा से 'दाईं ओर' तथा दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में 'बाईं ओर' मुड़ जाती हैं।
explanation.hinglish: Ferrel's Law states that Coriolis force deflects any moving fluid to the right of its path in the Northern Hemisphere, and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere.

detailedExplanation.en: Ferrel's Law states that Coriolis force deflects any moving fluid to the right of its path in the Northern Hemisphere, and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere. Key takeaway: Coriolis deflection = Right in North, Left in South.
detailedExplanation.hi: फेरेल के नियम के अनुसार कोरिऑलिस बल के प्रभाव से उत्तरी गोलार्ध में बहने वाली सभी हवाएं अपनी गति की दिशा से 'दाईं ओर' तथा दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में 'बाईं ओर' मुड़ जाती हैं। मुख्य बिंदु: कोरिऑलिस विक्षेपण = उत्तर में दाईं ओर, दक्षिण में बाईं ओर।

question.en: In which layer of the Earth's atmosphere do high-altitude, fast-flowing meandering air currents known as 'Jet Streams' predominantly circulate?

question.hinglish: In which layer of the Earth's atmosphere do high-altitude, fast-flowing meandering air currents known as 'Jet Streams' predominantly circulate?

explanation.en: Jet streams are fast-moving ribbons of wind circulating near the tropopause (the transition between troposphere and stratosphere) at altitudes of 9 to 14 km.

question.en: Which synthetic greenhouse gas, widely used as an electrical insulator in high-voltage circuit breakers, possesses the highest Global Warming Potential (GWP) of approximately 23,500 over a 100-year timescale?

question.hinglish: Which synthetic greenhouse gas, widely used as an electrical insulator in high-voltage circuit breakers, possesses the highest Global Warming Potential (GWP) of approximately 23,500 over a 100-year timescale?

explanation.en: Sulfur Hexafluoride (SF6) is the most potent greenhouse gas evaluated by the IPCC, having a Global Warming Potential roughly 23,500 times that of CO2 and an atmospheric lifetime of 3,200 years.

question.en: In which unit of measurement is the total column thickness of stratospheric ozone conventionally quantified, where 1 unit corresponds to a layer 0.01 mm thick at STP?
question.hi: समतापमंडलीय ओजोन परत की कुल मोटाई को पारंपरिक रूप से किस इकाई में मापा जाता है, जहां 1 इकाई मानक तापमान और दाब पर 0.01 मिमी मोटाई के बराबर होती है?
question.hinglish: In which unit of measurement is the total column thickness of stratospheric ozone conventionally quantified, where 1 unit corresponds to a layer 0.01 mm thick at STP?

explanation.en: The Dobson Unit (DU) is the standard unit for measuring atmospheric ozone. A normal baseline column ozone level is around 300 to 350 DU, with values under 220 DU defining an 'ozone hole'.
explanation.hi: ओजोन परत की सघनता और मोटाई 'डॉबसन यूनिट' (DU) में मापी जाती है; 220 DU से कम मान को 'ओजोन छिद्र' की स्थिति माना जाता है।

question.en: The upward propulsion and flight of a multi-stage space rocket operates fundamentally on the principle of conservation of which physical quantity?

question.en: What is the minimum escape velocity required for an object launched from the surface of the Earth to overcome its gravitational field and enter interplanetary space?
question.hi: पृथ्वी की सतह से किसी वस्तु को अंतरिक्ष में भेजने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम 'पलायन वेग' (Escape Velocity) का मान लगभग कितना होता है?
question.hinglish: What is the minimum escape velocity required for an object launched from the surface of the Earth to overcome its gravitational field and enter interplanetary space?

question.en: If the velocity of a moving motor vehicle is doubled, by what factor does its kinetic energy increase?
question.hi: यदि किसी गतिमान वाहन का वेग (गति) दोगुना कर दिया जाए, तो उसकी गतिज ऊर्जा (Kinetic Energy) कितने गुना बढ़ जाएगी?
question.hinglish: If the velocity of a moving motor vehicle is doubled, by what factor does its kinetic energy increase?

explanation.en: Kinetic energy is directly proportional to the square of velocity (KE = 1/2 m v²). Therefore, doubling the velocity (2v) increases KE by (2)² = 4 times.
explanation.hi: गतिज ऊर्जा का सूत्र KE = 1/2 m v² होता है। चूंकि गतिज ऊर्जा वेग के वर्ग के समानुपाती होती है, अतः वेग दोगुना करने पर गतिज ऊर्जा (2)² = 4 गुना हो जाती है।

question.en: Which wave phenomenon can be exhibited exclusively by transverse waves (such as light), but NEVER by longitudinal waves (such as sound)?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी तरंगीय परिघटना केवल अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों (जैसे प्रकाश) द्वारा प्रदर्शित की जा सकती है, किंतु अनुदैर्ध्य तरंगों (जैसे ध्वनि) द्वारा कभी नहीं?
question.hinglish: Which wave phenomenon can be exhibited exclusively by transverse waves (such as light), but NEVER by longitudinal waves (such as sound)?

explanation.en: Polarization is the restriction of wave vibrations to a single plane, a property exclusive to transverse waves because their oscillations are perpendicular to travel.
explanation.hi: ध्रुवण (Polarization) केवल अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों का विशिष्ट गुण है; चूंकि ध्वनि एक अनुदैर्ध्य तरंग है जिसमें दोलन संचरण की दिशा में होते हैं, अतः ध्वनि का ध्रुवण संभव नहीं है।
explanation.hinglish: Polarization is the restriction of wave vibrations to a single plane, a property exclusive to transverse waves because their oscillations are perpendicular to travel.

detailedExplanation.en: Polarization is the restriction of wave vibrations to a single plane, a property exclusive to transverse waves because their oscillations are perpendicular to travel. Key takeaway: Polarization occurs in Transverse waves only (Light, NOT Sound).
detailedExplanation.hi: ध्रुवण (Polarization) केवल अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों का विशिष्ट गुण है; चूंकि ध्वनि एक अनुदैर्ध्य तरंग है जिसमें दोलन संचरण की दिशा में होते हैं, अतः ध्वनि का ध्रुवण संभव नहीं है। मुख्य बिंदु: केवल अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों में ध्रुवण होता है (प्रकाश में होता है, ध्वनि में नहीं)।
detailedExplanation.hinglish: Polarization is the restriction of wave vibrations to a single plane, a property exclusive to transverse waves because their oscillations are perpendicular to travel. Key takeaway: Polarization occurs in Transverse waves only (Light, NOT Sound).

question.en: Through which of the following media does sound propagate with the HIGHEST velocity?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस माध्यम में ध्वनि की चाल सर्वाधिक (सबसे तेज) होती है?
question.hinglish: Through which of the following media does sound propagate with the HIGHEST velocity?

explanation.en: Sound propagates fastest through dense elastic solids where molecular bonds are stiff; in steel it travels at ~5,100 m/s, compared to ~1,480 m/s in water and ~343 m/s in air.
explanation.hi: ध्वनि की चाल माध्यम के प्रत्यास्थता गुणांक पर निर्भर करती है; इस्पात (ठोस) में ध्वनि लगभग 5,100 मीटर/सेकंड की गति से चलती है, जबकि निर्वात में ध्वनि का संचरण शून्य होता है।

question.en: Modern high-speed optical fiber communications transmit data pulses based on which fundamental optical phenomenon?
question.hi: आधुनिक उच्च गति इंटरनेट ऑप्टिकल फाइबर (प्रकाश तंतु) केबल में डेटा संकेतों का संचरण प्रकाश की किस परिघटना पर आधारित होता है?
question.hinglish: Modern high-speed optical fiber communications transmit data pulses based on which fundamental optical phenomenon?

explanation.en: Optical fibers consist of a glass/plastic core surrounded by cladding with a lower refractive index, trapping light pulses completely inside via repeated Total Internal Reflection (TIR).
explanation.hi: ऑप्टिकल फाइबर के कोर का अपवर्तनांक क्लैडिंग से अधिक रखा जाता है, जिससे प्रकाश किरणें अंदर ही अंदर बार-बार पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (TIR) करते हुए बिना ऊर्जा क्षय के लंबी दूरी तय करती हैं।

question.en: Which corrective optical lens is prescribed to correct Myopia (near-sightedness), where light rays from a distant object focus in front of the retina?

question.hinglish: Which corrective optical lens is prescribed to correct Myopia (near-sightedness), where light rays from a distant object focus in front of the retina?

explanation.en: A concave (diverging) lens diverges incoming parallel light rays before they enter the eye, allowing them to focus exactly onto the retina to correct Myopia.

question.en: The existence of the atomic nucleus was experimentally demonstrated in 1911 through the famous gold foil alpha-particle scattering experiment conducted by:

question.en: Which major digestive secretion produced by the liver contains NO digestive enzymes, yet is indispensable for the emulsification and digestion of dietary fats?

question.en: Which specialized patch of neuromuscular tissue situated in the right atrium acts as the natural 'Pacemaker' of the human heart by initiating rhythmic electrical impulses?

question.hinglish: Which specialized patch of neuromuscular tissue situated in the right atrium acts as the natural 'Pacemaker' of the human heart by initiating rhythmic electrical impulses?

question.en: Which major anatomical region of the human brain is primarily responsible for maintaining muscular coordination, posture, and body balance during voluntary movement?
question.hi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग ऐच्छिक गतियों के दौरान मांसपेशियों के समन्वय, शारीरिक संतुलन और मुद्रा (Posture) को नियंत्रित करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से उत्तरदायी होता है?

question.en: Which hormone, secreted by the beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the pancreas, is responsible for lowering blood glucose levels by facilitating cellular uptake?

question.hinglish: Which hormone, secreted by the beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the pancreas, is responsible for lowering blood glucose levels by facilitating cellular uptake?

question.hinglish: Which complex vascular plant tissue conducts water and dissolved mineral nutrients unidirectionally from the roots upward to the stems and leaves?

explanation.en: Xylem is the specialized conducting tissue that transports water and dissolved inorganic ions upward from roots driven by transpirational pull and root pressure.

question.en: In the biochemical process of oxygenic photosynthesis, from which reactant molecule is molecular oxygen (O2) released into the atmosphere?
question.hi: पौधों में प्रकाश संश्लेषण की जैव-रासायनिक प्रक्रिया के दौरान वायुमंडल में मुक्त होने वाली ऑक्सीजन (O2) किस अणु के प्रकाशिक अपघटन से प्राप्त होती है?
question.hinglish: In the biochemical process of oxygenic photosynthesis, from which reactant molecule is molecular oxygen (O2) released into the atmosphere?

explanation.en: Photolysis of water (splitting of H2O into protons, electrons, and oxygen) driven by Photosystem II in the thylakoid membrane is the true source of all photosynthetic O2.
explanation.hi: प्रकाशिक अभिक्रिया में सूर्य के प्रकाश द्वारा जल के अणुओं का विखंडन (Photolysis of water) होता है, जिससे ऑक्सीजन गैस मुक्त होती है (CO2 से ग्लूकोज बनता है)।

question.en: Which widely accepted physical theory, formulated by Dixon and Joly in 1894, explains the ascent of sap through xylem vessels in tall trees?

explanation.en: Dixon and Joly's Cohesion-Tension Theory demonstrates that transpirational pull creates negative tension transmitted down the continuous cohesive column of water in xylem.

question.en: In a Full Mesh network topology connecting 10 computers directly with dedicated physical point-to-point links, how many total communication cables are required?

question.hinglish: In a Full Mesh network topology connecting 10 computers directly with dedicated physical point-to-point links, how many total communication cables are required?

question.en: Which famous lyric poem (Khandakavya) by Kalidasa narrates the poignant longing of an exiled Yaksha who dispatches a rain-bearing monsoon cloud as his messenger to his beloved wife in Alaka?

explanation.en: Maharishi Kanada (also called Kashyapa) founded the Vaisheshika school around the 6th-2nd century BCE, formulating the atomic concept of Paramāṇu centuries before Greek philosophers like Democritus.

explanation.en: The Most Favoured Nation (MFN) principle (GATT Article I) forbids discrimination between trading partners: every member must accord all other WTO members the best trading terms it offers to any single country.
explanation.hi: सर्वाधिक पसंदीदा राष्ट्र (MFN) का नियम यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि विश्व व्यापार में किसी एक देश के साथ पक्षपात न हो; यदि एक सदस्य देश को आयात शुल्क में राहत दी जाती है, तो वह स्वतः सभी WTO सदस्यों पर लागू हो जाती है।

Key takeaway: Equal treatment to all trading partners = Most Favoured Nation (MFN).

question.en: Which sacred ancient Hindu scripture is the source of India's national motto 'सत्यमेव जयते' (Satyameva Jayate - Truth Alone Triumphs), inscribed below the National Emblem?

question.hinglish: Which sacred ancient Hindu scripture is the source of India's national motto 'सत्यमेव जयते' (Satyameva Jayate - Truth Alone Triumphs), inscribed below the National Emblem?

question.en: What is the mandatory legal dimensional ratio of the LENGTH to the BREADTH (height) of the National Flag of India as codified in the Flag Code of India?
question.hi: भारतीय ध्वज संहिता (Flag Code of India) के अनुसार भारत के राष्ट्रीय ध्वज की 'लंबाई' और 'चौड़ाई' (ऊंचाई) का अनिवार्य वैधानिक अनुपात क्या निर्धारित है?
question.hinglish: What is the mandatory legal dimensional ratio of the LENGTH to the BREADTH (height) of the National Flag of India as codified in the Flag Code of India?

explanation.en: The Flag Code of India explicitly prescribes that the ratio of the length to the height (breadth) of the National Flag shall be 3:2.
explanation.hi: भारत के राष्ट्रीय ध्वज की लंबाई और चौड़ाई का अनुपात 3:2 होना चाहिए। यदि लंबाई 3 फीट है तो चौड़ाई 2 फीट होगी।

question.en: Under the landmark 2019 redefinition of SI base units, which fundamental physical quantum constant is fixed at exactly 6.62607015 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s to define the 'Kilogram'?

question.en: One mechanical Horsepower (hp), a traditional imperial unit of mechanical power still widely used in automotive and industrial engines, is equivalent to exactly how many Watts in SI units?

question.hinglish: One mechanical Horsepower (hp), a traditional imperial unit of mechanical power still widely used in automotive and industrial engines, is equivalent to exactly how many Watts in SI units?

explanation.en: One imperial horsepower (defined by James Watt as 550 foot-pounds per second) corresponds to approximately 745.7, rounded universally in standard physics exams to 746 Watts.

explanation.en: The prefix 'femto-' represents a factor of 10⁻¹⁵ (one quadrillionth), derived from the Danish/Norwegian word 'femten' meaning fifteen. A femtometer (10⁻¹⁵ m) is universally called a Fermi.

evidence.quote: At Devprayag in Uttarakhand, the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda. Below this confluence, the river is officially called the Ganga.

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Godavari, with a length of 1,465 km, is the longest peninsular river in India. It originates at Trimbakeshwar in Maharashtra and drains into the Bay of Bengal.
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 1,465 किमी लंबी गोदावरी भारत की सबसे लंबी प्रायद्वीपीय नदी है। यह महाराष्ट्र के त्र्यंबकेश्वर से निकलकर बंगाल की खाड़ी में गिरती है।

evidence.quote: The Godavari, with a length of 1,465 km, is the longest peninsular river in India. It originates at Trimbakeshwar in Maharashtra and drains into the Bay of Bengal.

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Narmada River flows westward in a linear rift valley formed between the Vindhyan range to the north and the Satpura range to the south.
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: नर्मदा नदी उत्तर में विंध्याचल श्रेणी और दक्षिण में सतपुड़ा श्रेणी के बीच एक भ्रंश घाटी में पश्चिम की ओर बहती है।

evidence.quote: The Narmada River flows westward in a linear rift valley formed between the Vindhyan range to the north and the Satpura range to the south.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Western Disturbances originating over the Mediterranean Sea bring vital winter showers to North-West India, benefiting the Rabi wheat crop.
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: भूमध्य सागर से उत्पन्न होने वाले पश्चिमी विक्षोभ उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत में शीतकालीन वर्षा लाते हैं, जो रबी की गेहूं की फसल के लिए अत्यंत लाभदायक होती है।

evidence.quote: Western Disturbances originating over the Mediterranean Sea bring vital winter showers to North-West India, benefiting the Rabi wheat crop.

factCards.canonicalStatement: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan & Multimodal Connectivity: PM Gati Shakti = 7 infrastructure engines. 7 engines of economic growth
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: पीएम गति शक्ति राष्ट्रीय मास्टर प्लान एवं मल्टीमॉडल कनेक्टिविटी: पीएम गति शक्ति = 7 बुनियादी ढांचागत इंजन। आर्थिक विकास के 7 इंजन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan & Multimodal Connectivity.

factCards.canonicalStatement: G20 New Delhi Leaders' Declaration & African Union Induction: African Union = Newest G20 permanent member. Consensus on 100% paragraphs at New Delhi Summit 2023
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: जी20 नई दिल्ली घोषणापत्र एवं अफ्रीकी संघ का स्थायी प्रवेश: अफ्रीकी संघ = जी20 का नया स्थायी सदस्य। नई दिल्ली शिखर सम्मेलन 2023 में 100% पैराग्राफ पर आम सहमति
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for G20 New Delhi Leaders' Declaration & African Union Induction.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Chandrayaan-3 Mission: Lunar South Pole Soft Landing & Pragyan Rover: Chandrayaan-3 landing = Shiv Shakti Point. Soft landing on 23 August 2023 near Lunar South Pole (Shiv Shakti Point)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: चंद्रयान-3 मिशन: चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुव पर सॉफ्ट लैंडिंग एवं प्रज्ञान रोवर: चंद्रयान-3 लैंडिंग स्थल = शिव शक्ति पॉइंट। 23 अगस्त 2023 को दक्षिणी ध्रुव के निकट सॉफ्ट लैंडिंग (शिव शक्ति पॉइंट)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Chandrayaan-3 Mission: Lunar South Pole Soft Landing & Pragyan Rover.

factCards.canonicalStatement: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC): IMEC = India -> Gulf / Middle East -> Europe. Unveiled at G20 New Delhi Summit 2023
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: भारत-मध्य पूर्व-यूरोप आर्थिक गलियारा (IMEC): IMEC = भारत -> खाड़ी / मध्य पूर्व -> यूरोप। जी20 नई दिल्ली शिखर सम्मेलन 2023 में घोषित
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Quad Leaders' Summit & Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA): Quad = India, US, Japan, Australia. Quad members: India, USA, Japan, Australia
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: क्वाड (Quad) शिखर सम्मेलन एवं इंडो-पैसिफिक समुद्री डोमेन जागरूकता (IPMDA): क्वाड = भारत, अमेरिका, जापान, ऑस्ट्रेलिया। क्वाड सदस्य: भारत, अमेरिका, जापान, ऑस्ट्रेलिया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Quad Leaders' Summit & Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA).

factCards.canonicalStatement: COP28 Climate Summit: Loss and Damage Fund & Global Stocktake: COP28 = Dubai, UAE (2023). Hosted in Dubai (UAE) in December 2023
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: कॉप-28 जलवायु सम्मेलन: लॉस एंड डैमेज फंड एवं ग्लोबल स्टॉकटेक: कॉप-28 = दुबई, यूएई (2023)। दिसंबर 2023 में दुबई (यूएई) में आयोजित
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for COP28 Climate Summit: Loss and Damage Fund & Global Stocktake.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Aditya-L1 Solar Observatory Mission & Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 1: Aditya-L1 = L1 point (1.5 million km from Earth). First Indian space-based observatory to study the Sun
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: आदित्य-L1 सौर वेधशाला मिशन एवं सूर्य-पृथ्वी लैग्रेंज बिंदु 1: आदित्य-L1 = L1 बिंदु (पृथ्वी से 15 लाख किमी)। सूर्य के अध्ययन हेतु भारत की पहली अंतरिक्ष-आधारित वेधशाला
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Aditya-L1 Solar Observatory Mission & Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 1.

factCards.canonicalStatement: INS Vikrant & Indigenous Aircraft Carrier Capabilities: Indigenous carrier = INS Vikrant. India's first indigenously built aircraft carrier (IAC-1)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: आईएनएस विक्रांत एवं स्वदेशी विमानवाहक पोत क्षमताएं: पहला स्वदेशी विमानवाहक पोत = आईएनएस विक्रांत। भारत का पहला स्वदेश निर्मित विमानवाहक पोत (IAC-1)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for INS Vikrant & Indigenous Aircraft Carrier Capabilities.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Digital Public Infrastructure: UPI Global Expansion & ONDC: UPI & RuPay = NPCI. Unified Payments Interface (UPI) developed by NPCI
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: डिजिटल सार्वजनिक अवसंरचना: यूपीआई का वैश्विक विस्तार एवं ओएनडीसी: यूपीआई और रुपे = एनपीसीआई (NPCI)। एनपीसीआई द्वारा विकसित एकीकृत भुगतान इंटरफेस (UPI)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Digital Public Infrastructure: UPI Global Expansion & ONDC.

factCards.canonicalStatement: National Quantum Mission & Quantum Technologies: Quantum Bit = Qubit. Approved by Union Cabinet with outlay of ₹6,003 crore
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: राष्ट्रीय क्वांटम मिशन एवं क्वांटम प्रौद्योगिकी: क्वांटम बिट = क्यूबिट। केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा ₹6,003 करोड़ के परिव्यय के साथ स्वीकृत
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for National Quantum Mission & Quantum Technologies.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Deep Ocean Mission & Matsya 6000 Submersible: Samudrayaan submersible = Matsya 6000. Ministry of Earth Sciences initiative (Samudrayaan project)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: डीप ओशन मिशन एवं मत्स्य-6000 पनडुब्बी (Samudrayaan): समुद्रयान पनडुब्बी = मत्स्य 6000। पृथ्वी विज्ञान मंत्रालय की पहल (समुद्रयान परियोजना)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Deep Ocean Mission & Matsya 6000 Submersible.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Prehistoric Rock Art & Paleolithic to Neolithic Sites (Bhimbetka, Burzahom): Bhimbetka = Madhya Pradesh (discovered by V.S. Wakankar). Bhimbetka rock shelters (Madhya Pradesh, V.S. Wakankar 1957)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: प्रागैतिहासिक शैलचित्र एवं पुरापाषाण से नवपाषाण स्थल (भीमबेटका, बुर्जहोम): भीमबेटका = मध्य प्रदेश (वाकणकर द्वारा 1957 में खोजा गया)। भीमबेटका शैलचित्र (मध्य प्रदेश, वी.एस. वाकणकर 1957)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Prehistoric Rock Art & Paleolithic to Neolithic Sites (Bhimbetka, Burzahom).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Indus Valley Civilization: Urban Planning, Great Bath & Drainage System: Harappan brick ratio = 4:2:1. Grid layout (Chessboard system)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता: नगर नियोजन, विशाल स्नानागार एवं जल निकासी: हड़प्पा की ईंटों का अनुपात = 4 : 2 : 1। ग्रिड प्रणाली (चेसबोर्ड पैटर्न) पर आधारित सड़कें
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Indus Valley Civilization: Urban Planning, Great Bath & Drainage System.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Mohenjo-daro & Harappa: Great Bath, Granaries & Bronze Artifacts: Dancing Girl & Great Bath = Mohenjo-daro. Great Bath at Mohenjo-daro lined with bitumen/gypsum
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मोहनजोदड़ो एवं हड़प्पा: विशाल स्नानागार, अन्नागार एवं कांस्य शिल्प: नर्तकी की कांस्य मूर्ति व विशाल स्नानागार = मोहनजोदड़ो। मोहनजोदड़ो का विशाल स्नानागार जिप्सम व बिटुमेन से जलरोधी
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Mohenjo-daro & Harappa: Great Bath, Granaries & Bronze Artifacts.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Lothal, Kalibangan, Dholavira & Rakhigarhi: Special Architectural Features: Dholavira = 3 parts + Water reservoirs. Lothal dockyard on Bhogava river in Gujarat
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: लोथल, कालीबंगा, धोलावीरा एवं राखीगढ़ी: विशिष्ट पुरातात्विक विशेषताएं: धोलावीरा = 3 नगर भाग + विशाल जलाशय। गुजरात में भोगवा नदी पर लोथल का गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Lothal, Kalibangan, Dholavira & Rakhigarhi: Special Architectural Features.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Harappan Script, Seals, Weights, Measures & Craft Production: Boustrophedon = Harappan bidirectional script. Steatite seals featuring unicorn, bull, elephant
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: हड़प्पा लिपि, मुहरें, बांट, माप एवं शिल्प उत्पादन: बोस्ट्रोफेडन = दाएं-बाएं-दाएं क्रमिक लेखन शैली। सेलखड़ी (स्टीएटाइट) की मुहरें जिन पर एकश्रृंगी, बैल आदि अंकित
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Harappan Script, Seals, Weights, Measures & Craft Production.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Decline Theories of the Indus Valley Civilization: Mortimer Wheeler = Proposed Aryan invasion decline theory. Aryan invasion theory (Mortimer Wheeler, now rejected)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के पतन के सिद्धांत: मार्टिमर व्हीलर = आर्य आक्रमण सिद्धांत। आर्य आक्रमण सिद्धांत (मार्टिमर व्हीलर, अब अमान्य)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Decline Theories of the Indus Valley Civilization.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Rigvedic Society, Tribes (Janas), Sabha & Samiti: Dasarajna = Parushni (Ravi). Pastoral society centered on cattle (Gavishthi)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: ऋग्वैदिक समाज, जन (कबीले), सभा एवं समिति: दशराज्ञ युद्ध = परुष्णी (रावी नदी)। गोधन पर आधारित पशुचारी समाज (गविष्टि)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Rigvedic Society, Tribes (Janas), Sabha & Samiti.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Later Vedic Period: Painted Grey Ware, Varna System & Sacrificial Rituals: 4 Ashramas = Jabala Upanishad. Painted Grey Ware (PGW) culture & iron implements (Syama Ayas)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: उत्तर वैदिक काल: चित्रित धूसर मृदभांड, वर्ण व्यवस्था एवं महायज्ञ: चारों आश्रम = जाबाल उपनिषद। चित्रित धूसर मृदभांड (PGW) एवं लोहे का प्रयोग (श्याम अयस)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Later Vedic Period: Painted Grey Ware, Varna System & Sacrificial Rituals.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Vedic Literature: Four Vedas, Brahmanas, Aranyakas & Upanishads: Sama = Song / Music. Rigveda (1,028 suktas), Samaveda (music), Yajurveda (rituals), Atharvaveda (charms)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: वैदिक साहित्य: चार वेद, ब्राह्मण ग्रंथ, आरण्यक एवं उपनिषद (वेदांत): साम = गान / संगीत का वेद। ऋग्वेद (1028 सूक्त), सामवेद (संगीत), यजुर्वेद (कर्मकांड), अथर्ववेद (औषधि व मंत्र)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Vedic Literature: Four Vedas, Brahmanas, Aranyakas & Upanishads.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Rise of 16 Mahajanapadas & Magadha Hegemony (Haryanka, Shishunaga, Nanda): 16 Mahajanapadas = Anguttara Nikaya (also Bhagavati Sutra in Jainism). Anguttara Nikaya lists 16 Mahajanapadas in 6th century BCE
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 16 महाजनपदों का उदय एवं मगध का उत्कर्ष (हर्यंक, शिशुनाग, नंद वंश): 16 महाजनपद = अंगुत्तर निकाय (एवं जैन भगवती सूत्र)। अंगुत्तर निकाय (बौद्ध ग्रंथ) में 16 महाजनपदों की सूची
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Rise of 16 Mahajanapadas & Magadha Hegemony (Haryanka, Shishunaga, Nanda).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Persian Invasions (Darius I) & Alexander's Campaign in Punjab (326 BCE): Battle of Hydaspes (Jhelum) = Alexander vs Porus (326 BCE). Achaemenid invasion: Cyrus & Darius I (Bahistun & Persepolis inscriptions)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: ईरानी आक्रमण (डेरियस प्रथम) एवं सिकंदर का पंजाब अभियान (326 ई.पू.): हाइडैस्पीज (झेलम) का युद्ध = सिकंदर बनाम पोरस (326 ई.पू.)। हखामनी आक्रमण: साइरस व डेरियस प्रथम (बेहिस्तून व पर्सीपोलिस अभिलेख)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Persian Invasions (Darius I) & Alexander's Campaign in Punjab (326 BCE).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Second Urbanization & Iron Metallurgy in the Middle Ganga Valley: Earliest Indian coins = Punch-marked coins (Karshapana). Second urbanization emergence (6th century BCE)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: द्वितीय नगरीकरण एवं मध्य गंगा घाटी में लौह धातु विज्ञान: भारत के प्राचीनतम सिक्के = आहत सिक्के (कार्षापण)। छठी शताब्दी ई.पू. में द्वितीय नगरीकरण का उदय
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Second Urbanization & Iron Metallurgy in the Middle Ganga Valley.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Gautama Buddha: Life, Enlightenment, Four Noble Truths & Eightfold Path: First Sermon = Sarnath. Siddhartha Gautama born in Lumbini (Shakya clan)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: गौतम बुद्ध: जीवन, संबोधि, चार आर्य सत्य एवं अष्टांगिक मार्ग: पहला उपदेश = सारनाथ। सिद्धार्थ गौतम का जन्म लुंबिनी में (शाक्य कुल)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Gautama Buddha: Life, Enlightenment, Four Noble Truths & Eightfold Path.

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Four Buddhist Councils: Patrons, Venues, Presiding Monks & Outcomes: Fourth Council = Kanishka in Kashmir. First Council: Rajgriha (Ajatashatru, Mahakassapa) - compiled Sutta & Vinaya
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: चार बौद्ध संगीतियां: संरक्षक, स्थल, अध्यक्ष एवं ऐतिहासिक परिणाम: चौथी संगीति = कनिष्क, कश्मीर (कुंडलवन)। प्रथम संगीति: राजगृह (अजातशत्रु, महाकस्सप) - सुत्त व विनय पिटक का संकलन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for The Four Buddhist Councils: Patrons, Venues, Presiding Monks & Outcomes.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Vardhamana Mahavira & Jain Philosophy: Triratna, Anekantavada & Syadvada: Anekantavada = Jain doctrine of manifold viewpoints. Vardhamana Mahavira (24th Tirthankara, Jnatrika clan)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: वर्धमान महावीर एवं जैन दर्शन: त्रिरत्न, अनेकांतवाद एवं स्याद्वाद: अनेकांतवाद = जैन दर्शन का बहुलतावादी सिद्धांत। वर्धमान महावीर (24वें तीर्थंकर, ज्ञातृक कुल)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Vardhamana Mahavira & Jain Philosophy: Triratna, Anekantavada & Syadvada.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Sects of Jainism: Digambaras, Svetambaras & Sacred Agamas: Gommateshwara statue = Chavundaraya at Shravanabelagola. Great famine in Magadha led Bhadrabahu to migrate to Shravanabelagola (Digambara)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: जैन धर्म के संप्रदाय: दिगंबर, श्वेतांबर एवं जैन आगम साहित्य: गोमटेश्वर बाहुबली प्रतिमा = चामुंडराय, श्रवणबेलगोला। मगध अकाल के समय भद्रबाहु का दक्षिण (श्रवणबेलगोला) प्रवास (दिगंबर परंपरा)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Sects of Jainism: Digambaras, Svetambaras & Sacred Agamas.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Heterodox Philosophies: Charvaka (Lokayata) & Ajivika Sect: Ajivika = Makkhali Gosala (Niyati). Charvaka (Brihaspati): Materialism, Pratyaksha (perception) only valid pramana, rejection of afterlife/rebirth
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: नास्तिक व श्रमण संप्रदाय: चार्वाक (लोकायत) एवं आजीवक दर्शन: आजीवक संप्रदाय = मक्खलि गोशाल (नियतिवाद)। चार्वाक (बृहस्पति): भौतिकवाद, केवल प्रत्यक्ष ही एकमात्र प्रमाण, पुनर्जन्म व मोक्ष का खंडन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Heterodox Philosophies: Charvaka (Lokayata) & Ajivika Sect.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Buddhist Art: Stupas, Chaityas, Viharas & Sanchi: Top railing of Stupa = Harmika. Stupa architectural elements: Anda, Harmika, Chhatra, Pradakshina Path, Torana gateways
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: बौद्ध कला: स्तूप, चैत्य, विहार एवं सांची का महास्तूप: स्तूप के शीर्ष पर स्थित रेलिंग = हर्मिका। स्तूप संरचना के अंग: अंड, हर्मिका, छत्र, प्रदक्षिणा पथ, तोरण द्वार
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Buddhist Art: Stupas, Chaityas, Viharas & Sanchi.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Spread of Buddhism to Central, East & Southeast Asia: Mahendra & Sanghamitra = Sri Lanka. Ashoka sent Mahendra and Sanghamitta to Sri Lanka (Tamraparni)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मध्य, पूर्व एवं दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया में बौद्ध धर्म का प्रसार: महेंद्र और संघमित्रा = श्रीलंका। अशोक ने पुत्र महेंद्र व पुत्री संघमित्रा को श्रीलंका (ताम्रपर्णी) भेजा
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Spread of Buddhism to Central, East & Southeast Asia.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Chandragupta Maurya, Chanakya & Kautilya's Arthashastra Administration: Saptanga = 7 limbs of state in Arthashastra. Overthrow of Dhana Nanda (c. 321 BCE) with help of Kautilya (Vishnugupta)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य, चाणक्य एवं कौटिल्य का अर्थशास्त्र: प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था: सप्तांग = राज्य के 7 अंग (कौटिल्य)। चाणक्य (विष्णुगुप्त) की सहायता से नंद वंश का उन्मूलन (321 ई.पू.)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Chandragupta Maurya, Chanakya & Kautilya's Arthashastra Administration.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Megasthenes' Indica & Mauryan Municipal Administration of Pataliputra: Pataliputra administration = 6 boards × 5 members = 30. Megasthenes was Seleucid ambassador to Chandragupta Maurya's court
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मेगस्थनीज की इंडिका एवं पाटलिपुत्र का नगर प्रशासन: पाटलिपुत्र प्रशासन = 6 समितियां × 5 सदस्य = कुल 30। मेगस्थनीज सेल्यूकस निकेटर का राजदूत बनकर पाटलिपुत्र आया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Megasthenes' Indica & Mauryan Municipal Administration of Pataliputra.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Ashoka's Kalinga War (261 BCE), Dhamma Policy & Rock/Pillar Edicts: Kalinga War = Rock Edict XIII. Kalinga War fought in 8th regnal year (261 BCE); described in Major Rock Edict XIII
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: अशोक का कलिंग युद्ध (261 ई.पू.), धम्म नीति एवं शिलालेख/स्तंभलेख: कलिंग युद्ध = 13वां शिलालेख। राज्याभिषेक के 8वें वर्ष (261 ई.पू.) में कलिंग युद्ध; 13वें वृहद शिलालेख में हृदयविदारक वर्णन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Ashoka's Kalinga War (261 BCE), Dhamma Policy & Rock/Pillar Edicts.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Mauryan Art & Architecture: Ashokan Pillars, Lion Capital & Barabar Caves: Barabar caves = Dedicated to Ajivikas. Monolithic sandstone pillars with lustrous Mauryan polish (Chunar sandstone)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मौर्यकालीन कला एवं स्थापत्य: अशोक के एकाश्म स्तंभ, सिंह शीर्ष एवं बराबर गुफाएं: बराबर गुफाएं = आजीवक संप्रदाय हेतु। चुनार के बलुआ पत्थर से बने चमकदार पॉलिश वाले एकाश्म स्तंभ
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Mauryan Art & Architecture: Ashokan Pillars, Lion Capital & Barabar Caves.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Shungas, Kanvas & Indo-Greeks: Menander & Milinda Panha: Milinda Panha = King Menander + Nagasena. Pushyamitra Shunga assassinated Brihadratha (185 BCE), performed Ashvamedha
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: शुंग, कण्व एवं भारत-यूनानी: राजा मिनेंडर एवं मिलिंदपन्हो: मिलिंदपन्हो = राजा मिनेंडर + नागसेन। पुष्यमित्र शुंग ने अंतिम मौर्य राजा बृहद्रथ की हत्या कर शुंग वंश स्थापित किया (185 ई.पू.)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Shungas, Kanvas & Indo-Greeks: Menander & Milinda Panha.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Kushana Empire: Kanishka, Gandhara & Mathura Art Schools: Saka Era 78 CE = Kanishka. Kanishka started Saka Era (78 CE), capital Purushapura (Peshawar)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: कुषाण साम्राज्य: कनिष्क, गांधार एवं मथुरा कला शैलियां: शक संवत 78 ईस्वी = कनिष्क। कनिष्क ने 78 ईस्वी में शक संवत प्रारंभ किया; राजधानी पुरुषपुर (पेशावर)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Kushana Empire: Kanishka, Gandhara & Mathura Art Schools.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Satavahana Dynasty: Gautamiputra Satakarni & Deccan Trade: Eka-Brahmana = Gautamiputra Satakarni. Simuka founded Satavahanas in Deccan (capital Pratishthana/Paithan)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: सातवाहन राजवंश: गौतमीपुत्र शातकर्णी एवं दक्कन का व्यापार: एक-ब्राह्मण = गौतमीपुत्र शातकर्णी। सिमुक द्वारा दक्कन में सातवाहन वंश की स्थापना (राजधानी प्रतिष्ठान / पैठन)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Satavahana Dynasty: Gautamiputra Satakarni & Deccan Trade.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Gupta Empire: Samudragupta's Prayag Prashasti & Military Campaigns: Prayag Prashasti = Harishena (Samudragupta). Chandragupta I assumed title 'Maharajadhiraja' (Gupta Era 319-320 CE)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: गुप्त साम्राज्य: समुद्रगुप्त की प्रयाग प्रशस्ति एवं दिग्विजय अभियान: प्रयाग प्रशस्ति = हरिषेण (समुद्रगुप्त)। चंद्रगुप्त प्रथम ने 'महाराजाधिराज' की उपाधि धारण की (गुप्त संवत 319-320 ईस्वी)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Gupta Empire: Samudragupta's Prayag Prashasti & Military Campaigns.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Golden Age of Guptas: Sciences, Mathematics, Metallurgy & Nalanda University: Nalanda founded by Kumaragupta I. Aryabhata: Aryabhatiya, concept of zero, value of pi (3.1416), earth rotation
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: गुप्त काल का स्वर्ण युग: विज्ञान, गणित, धातु विज्ञान एवं नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय: नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय = कुमारगुप्त प्रथम। आर्यभट: आर्यभटीय, शून्य की अवधारणा, पाई का मान, पृथ्वी का अपनी धुरी पर घूर्णन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Golden Age of Guptas: Sciences, Mathematics, Metallurgy & Nalanda University.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Harshavardhana: Kannauj Assembly, Prayag Mahamoksha Parishad & Xuanzang: Harsha defeated by Pulakeshin II at Narmada. Pushyabhuti dynasty of Thanesar, shifted capital to Kannauj
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: हर्षवर्धन: कन्नौज धर्मसभा, प्रयाग महामोक्ष परिषद एवं ह्वेनसांग का यात्रा वृत्तांत: हर्षवर्धन पराजित = पुलकेशिन द्वितीय (नर्मदा तट, ऐहोल अभिलेख)। थानेश्वर के पुष्यभूति वंश के शासक, कन्नौज को नई राजधानी बनाया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Harshavardhana: Kannauj Assembly, Prayag Mahamoksha Parishad & Xuanzang.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Sangam Age: Cheras, Cholas, Pandyas, Tolkappiyam & Tamil Epics: Silappadikaram = Ilango Adigal (Kannagi's story). Three Sangams held in Madurai under Pandyan patronage
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संगम काल: चेर, चोल, पांड्य, तोलकाप्पियम एवं तमिल महाकाव्य: सिलप्पादिकारम = इलांगो अडिगल (कण्णगि की कथा)। पांड्य राजाओं के संरक्षण में मदुरै में तीन संगमों का आयोजन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Sangam Age: Cheras, Cholas, Pandyas, Tolkappiyam & Tamil Epics.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Tripartite Struggle for Kannauj: Gurjara-Pratiharas, Palas & Rashtrakutas: Tripartite = Pratiharas + Palas + Rashtrakutas. Centuries-long conflict for control of fertile Gangetic plains
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: कन्नौज का त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष: गुर्जर-प्रतिहार, पाल एवं राष्ट्रकूट: त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष = प्रतिहार + पाल + राष्ट्रकूट। गंगा के उपजाऊ मैदानों और महोदयश्री (कन्नौज) पर नियंत्रण हेतु 200 वर्षों का संघर्ष
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Tripartite Struggle for Kannauj: Gurjara-Pratiharas, Palas & Rashtrakutas.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Imperial Cholas: Navy, Brihadisvara Temple & Uttaramerur Inscription: Uttaramerur village assembly = Parantaka I Chola. Rajaraja I built Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur (1010 CE)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: शाही चोल साम्राज्य: नौसेना, वृहदेश्वर मंदिर एवं उत्तरमेरूर अभिलेख (स्थानीय स्वशासन): उत्तरमेरूर ग्रामीण स्वशासन अभिलेख = परांतक प्रथम चोल। राजराज प्रथम ने तंजावुर में भव्य वृहदेश्वर (राजराजेश्वर) मंदिर बनवाया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Imperial Cholas: Navy, Brihadisvara Temple & Uttaramerur Inscription.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Mahmud of Ghazni, Muhammad Ghori & Battles of Tarain (1191, 1192): Second Battle of Tarain 1192 = Prithviraj Chauhan defeated by Ghori. Mahmud of Ghazni 17 expeditions to India (Somnath Temple 1025 CE)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: महमूद गजनवी, मुहम्मद गोरी एवं तराइन के ऐतिहासिक युद्ध (1191, 1192): तराइन का द्वितीय युद्ध (1192) = पृथ्वीराज चौहान पराजित। महमूद गजनवी के भारत पर 17 आक्रमण (1025 ईस्वी में सोमनाथ मंदिर का विध्वंस)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Mahmud of Ghazni, Muhammad Ghori & Battles of Tarain (1191, 1192).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Slave Dynasty (Mamluks): Qutbuddin Aibak, Iltutmish & Razia Sultana: Tanka & Jital = Iltutmish. Qutbuddin Aibak (Lakh Baksh) founded Delhi Sultanate (1206), started Qutub Minar
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: गुलाम (मामलूक) वंश: कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक, इल्तुतमिश एवं रजिया सुल्तान: टंका और जीतल = इल्तुतमिश। कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक ('लाखबख्श') ने 1206 में सल्तनत की स्थापना की; कुतुब मीनार का निर्माण शुरू कराया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Slave Dynasty (Mamluks): Qutbuddin Aibak, Iltutmish & Razia Sultana.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Khalji Dynasty: Alauddin Khalji's Market Reforms, Price Control & Military Expansion: Market superintendent = Shahna-i-Mandi. Alauddin Khalji introduced price fixing of grains, cloth, horses via Shahna-i-Mandi
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: खिलजी वंश: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के बाजार सुधार, मूल्य नियंत्रण एवं दक्षिण विजय: बाजार अधीक्षक = शहना-ए-मंडी। अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने आवश्यक वस्तुओं की कीमतें तय कीं; 'शहना-ए-मंडी' की नियुक्ति
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Khalji Dynasty: Alauddin Khalji's Market Reforms, Price Control & Military Expansion.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Tughlaq Dynasty: Muhammad bin Tughlaq's Projects & Firoz Shah's Public Works: Ibn Battuta (Rihla) = Muhammad bin Tughlaq (1333). Muhammad bin Tughlaq visionary schemes: Taxation in Doab, Transfer of capital to Daulatabad (1327), Token currency (copper/brass), Khurasan expedition
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: तुगलक वंश: मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक की पांच योजनाएं एवं फिरोज शाह तुगलक के लोक निर्माण कार्य: इब्न बतूता (रेहला) = मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक। मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक की पांच योजनाएं: दोआब में कर वृद्धि, देवगिरि (दौलताबाद) राजधानी परिवर्तन, सांकेतिक मुद्रा का प्रचलन, खुरासान अभियान
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Tughlaq Dynasty: Muhammad bin Tughlaq's Projects & Firoz Shah's Public Works.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Foundations: Babur (Panipat 1526), Humayun & Sur Interregnum (Sher Shah): Silver Rupiya & GT Road = Sher Shah Suri. First Battle of Panipat (21 April 1526): Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi using Tulghuma tactic & artillery (cannons)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मुगल साम्राज्य की स्थापना: बाबर (पानीपत 1526), हुमायूं एवं सूर वंश (शेरशाह सूरी): चांदी का रुपिया और जीटी रोड = शेरशाह सूरी। पानीपत का प्रथम युद्ध (21 अप्रैल 1526): बाबर ने तुलगमा पद्धति व तोपखाने से इब्राहिम लोदी को हराया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Foundations: Babur (Panipat 1526), Humayun & Sur Interregnum (Sher Shah).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Akbar's Administrative Innovations: Mansabdari System & Dahsala Revenue System: Zat = Personal rank & pay; Sawar = Cavalry count. Mansabdari system: Dual ranks Zat (personal status/salary) and Sawar (cavalry contingent to maintain)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: अकबर के प्रशासनिक नवाचार: मनसबदारी व्यवस्था एवं आइन-ए-दहसाला भू-राजस्व प्रणाली: जात = व्यक्तिगत पद व वेतन; सवार = घुड़सवारों की संख्या। मनसबदारी व्यवस्था: दोहरे पद जात (व्यक्तिगत दर्जा व वेतन) और सवार (सैनिक व घुड़सवार टुकड़ी)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Akbar's Administrative Innovations: Mansabdari System & Dahsala Revenue System.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Akbar's Religious Policy: Sulh-i-Kul, Ibadat Khana & Din-i-Ilahi: Ibadat Khana = Fatehpur Sikri (1575). Abolition of Pilgrim Tax (1563) and Jizya (1564)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: अकबर की धार्मिक नीति: सुलह-ए-कुल, इबादत खाना, महजरनामा एवं दीन-ए-इलाही: इबादत खाना = फतेहपुर सीकरी (1575)। तीर्थयात्रा कर (1563) एवं गैर-मुसलमानों पर जजिया कर (1564) की समाप्ति
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Akbar's Religious Policy: Sulh-i-Kul, Ibadat Khana & Din-i-Ilahi.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Mughal Architecture: Humayun's Tomb, Fatehpur Sikri, Taj Mahal & Red Fort: Taj Mahal architect = Ustad Ahmad Lahori. Humayun's Tomb (Delhi, Mirak Mirza Ghiyas) - first garden-tomb (Charbagh) and precursor to Taj Mahal
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: मुगल स्थापत्य कला: हुमायूं का मकबरा, फतेहपुर सीकरी, ताजमहल एवं लाल किला: ताजमहल के मुख्य वास्तुकार = उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी। हुमायूं का मकबरा (दिल्ली, मीरक मिर्जा गियास): चारबाग शैली का पहला मकबरा, ताजमहल का अग्रदूत
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Mughal Architecture: Humayun's Tomb, Fatehpur Sikri, Taj Mahal & Red Fort.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Aurangzeb's Reign, Deccan Campaigns & Decline of the Mughal Empire: Jizya re-imposed = 1679 by Aurangzeb. War of Succession (1658): Defeated Dara Shikoh at Samugarh; titled Alamgir

factCards.canonicalStatement: Arrival of European Trading Companies: Portuguese, Dutch, English, Danes & French: Battle of Wandiwash (1760) = Eyre Coote defeats French. Vasco da Gama reached Calicut (May 1498) welcomed by Zamorin; Francisco de Almeida's Blue Water Policy

factCards.canonicalStatement: Battle of Plassey (1757), Battle of Buxar (1764) & Treaty of Allahabad (1765): Diwani rights 1765 = Treaty of Allahabad. Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757): Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah due to treachery of Mir Jafar, Rai Durlabh & Jagat Seth
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: प्लासी का युद्ध (1757), बक्सर का युद्ध (1764) एवं इलाहाबाद की संधि (1765): दीवानी अधिकार (1765) = इलाहाबाद की संधि। प्लासी का युद्ध (23 जून 1757): मीर जाफर, राय दुर्लभ व जगत सेठ के विश्वासघात से रॉबर्ट क्लाइव ने सिराजुद्दौला को हराया

factCards.canonicalStatement: Anglo-Mysore Wars: Hyder Ali, Tipu Sultan & the Fall of Srirangapatna (1799): Tipu Sultan fell = Fourth Anglo-Mysore War (1799). Four Anglo-Mysore Wars (1767–1799)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: आंग्ल-मैसूर युद्ध: हैदर अली, टीपू सुल्तान एवं श्रीरंगपट्टनम का पतन (1799): टीपू सुल्तान की शहादत = चतुर्थ आंग्ल-मैसूर युद्ध (1799)। चार आंग्ल-मैसूर युद्ध (1767-1799)

factCards.canonicalStatement: British Expansionist Policies: Subsidiary Alliance System & Doctrine of Lapse: Doctrine of Lapse first = Satara (1848). Subsidiary Alliance (Lord Wellesley, 1798): Indian rulers accepted British resident, disbanded own army, paid for Company troops; Nizam of Hyderabad first to sign (1798), followed by Mysore, Tanjore, Awadh, Peshwa (Bassein 1802)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: ब्रिटिश विस्तारवादी नीतियां: सहायक संधि प्रणाली (वेलेस्ली) एवं हड़प नीति (डलहौजी): हड़प नीति के तहत पहला विलय = सतारा (1848)। सहायक संधि (लॉर्ड वेलेस्ली, 1798): भारतीय शासक ब्रिटिश रेजीडेंट रखेंगे और विदेशी संबंध त्यागेंगे; हैदराबाद का निजाम सबसे पहले शामिल (1798), फिर मैसूर, तंजौर, अवध, मराठा
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for British Expansionist Policies: Subsidiary Alliance System & Doctrine of Lapse.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Colonial Land Revenue Systems: Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari & Mahalwari: Ryotwari = Thomas Munro (Madras 1820). Permanent Settlement (Zamindari System, 1793): Lord Cornwallis in Bengal, Bihar, Orissa; Zamindars made landlords with fixed 10/11th to Company and 1/11th to Zamindar; Sunset Law

factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Colonial Land Revenue Systems: Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari & Mahalwari.

factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 1857 का विद्रोह: मेरठ में विस्फोट, प्रमुख कारण एवं विद्रोह के मुख्य केंद्र: 1857 बिहार के नायक = वीर कुंवर सिंह (जगदीशपुर)। एनफील्ड राइफल के चर्बी वाले कारतूस (गाय व सूअर की चर्बी); बैरकपुर छावनी में मंगल पांडे का विद्रोह (29 मार्च 1857)

factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: स्वामी विवेकानंद, रामकृष्ण मिशन एवं थियोसोफिकल सोसाइटी: विवेकानंद का विश्व प्रसिद्ध भाषण = शिकागो (1893)। स्वामी विवेकानंद (नरेंद्रनाथ दत्त) रामकृष्ण परमहंस के शिष्य

factCards.canonicalStatement: Constitutional Evolution: Regulating Act 1773 to Government of India Act 1935: 1950 Constitution blueprint = Government of India Act 1935. Regulating Act 1773 established Supreme Court at Calcutta and made Governor of Bengal the Governor-General
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संवैधानिक विकास: 1773 का रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट से 1935 का भारत शासन अधिनियम: भारतीय संविधान का मुख्य स्रोत = 1935 का भारत शासन अधिनियम। 1773 का रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट: कलकत्ता में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना व वारेन हेस्टिंग्स पहले गवर्नर-जनरल बने
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Constitutional Evolution: Regulating Act 1773 to Government of India Act 1935.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Constituent Assembly: Formation, Committees, Drafting & Adoption (26 Nov 1949): Drafting Committee Chairman = Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Formed in Nov 1946 under Cabinet Mission Plan; 389 initial members, reduced to 299 after Partition
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संविधान सभा: गठन, समितियां, प्रारूप निर्माण एवं अंगीकरण (26 नवंबर 1949): प्रारूप समिति के अध्यक्ष = डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर। कैबिनेट मिशन योजना के तहत नवंबर 1946 में गठन; विभाजन के बाद 299 सदस्य
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Constituent Assembly: Formation, Committees, Drafting & Adoption (26 Nov 1949).

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Preamble to the Constitution: Philosophy, Key Terms & 42nd Amendment: 42nd Amendment 1976 = Socialist, Secular, Integrity. Based on Nehru's Objectives Resolution; acts as the key/soul of the Constitution
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संविधान की प्रस्तावना (उद्देशिका): दर्शन, मूल आदर्श एवं 42वां संविधान संशोधन: 42वां संशोधन 1976 = समाजवादी, पंथनिरपेक्ष, अखंडता। नेहरू के उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव पर आधारित; के.एम. मुंशी द्वारा 'संविधान की जन्मकुंडली' कहा गया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for The Preamble to the Constitution: Philosophy, Key Terms & 42nd Amendment.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Concept of State (Article 12) & Doctrine of Judicial Review (Article 13): Article 13 = Judicial review strikes down unconstitutional laws. Part III of Constitution (Articles 12 to 35) called Magna Carta of India
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: राज्य की परिभाषा (अनुच्छेद 12) एवं न्यायिक समीक्षा का सिद्धांत (अनुच्छेद 13): अनुच्छेद 13 = न्यायिक समीक्षा व मूल अधिकारों की सुरक्षा। संविधान का भाग III (अनुच्छेद 12 से 35) 'भारत का अधिकार-पत्र' (मैग्नाकार्टा) कहलाता है
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Concept of State (Article 12) & Doctrine of Judicial Review (Article 13).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Right to Equality: Articles 14 to 18 (Equality before Law & Abolition of Untouchability): Article 17 = Abolition of Untouchability. Article 14: Equality before law (British concept) and Equal protection of the laws (US concept)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: समता का अधिकार: अनुच्छेद 14 से 18 (विधि के समक्ष समता एवं अस्पृश्यता का अंत): अनुच्छेद 17 = अस्पृश्यता का अंत। अनुच्छेद 14: विधि के समक्ष समता (ब्रिटिश अवधारणा) और विधियों का समान संरक्षण (अमेरिकी अवधारणा)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Right to Equality: Articles 14 to 18 (Equality before Law & Abolition of Untouchability).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Right to Freedom: Article 19 Freedoms & Protection in Conviction (Article 20): Emergency immune rights = Articles 20 & 21. Article 19(1) guarantees 6 freedoms: speech/expression, peaceful assembly, association/unions, free movement throughout India, residence/settlement, trade/profession
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार: अनुच्छेद 19 की छह स्वतंत्रताएं एवं अपराधों के दोषसिद्धि के संबंध में संरक्षण (अनुच्छेद 20): आपातकाल में भी सुरक्षित अधिकार = अनुच्छेद 20 एवं 21। अनुच्छेद 19(1) में 6 मूल स्वतंत्रताएं: वाक् व अभिव्यक्ति, शांतिपूर्ण सम्मेलन, संगम/संघ/सहकारी समिति, भारत में निर्बाध संचरण, निवास और व्यापार/आजीविका
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Right to Freedom: Article 19 Freedoms & Protection in Conviction (Article 20).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Right to Life & Personal Liberty (Article 21), Right to Privacy & Right to Education (Article 21A): Right to Education (Art 21A) = 86th Amendment 2002. Article 21: 'No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law'
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: प्राण एवं दैहिक स्वतंत्रता (अनुच्छेद 21), निजता का अधिकार एवं शिक्षा का अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A): शिक्षा का मूल अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A) = 86वां संशोधन (2002)। अनुच्छेद 21: किसी व्यक्ति को उसके प्राण या दैहिक स्वतंत्रता से विधि द्वारा स्थापित प्रक्रिया के अनुसार ही वंचित किया जाएगा
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Right to Life & Personal Liberty (Article 21), Right to Privacy & Right to Education (Article 21A).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Right to Freedom of Religion (Articles 25 to 28) & Cultural/Educational Rights (Articles 29-30): Art 25 restrictions = Public order, Morality, Health. Article 25: Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion (subject to public order, morality, health)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 25 से 28) एवं संस्कृति व शिक्षा संबंधी अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 29-30): अनुच्छेद 25 के तीन प्रतिबंध = लोक व्यवस्था, सदाचार, स्वास्थ्य। अनुच्छेद 25: अंतःकरण की स्वतंत्रता, धर्म को अबाध रूप से मानने, आचरण और प्रचार करने का अधिकार (सार्वजनिक व्यवस्था, सदाचार व स्वास्थ्य के अधीन)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Right to Freedom of Religion (Articles 25 to 28) & Cultural/Educational Rights (Articles 29-30).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Right to Constitutional Remedies (Article 32): The Five High Prerogative Writs: Habeas Corpus = Release from unlawful custody. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar called Article 32 the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संवैधानिक उपचारों का अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 32): पांच प्रकार की ऐतिहासिक रिटें: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण = अवैध हिरासत से मुक्ति की रिट। डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर ने अनुच्छेद 32 को 'संविधान का हृदय और आत्मा' कहा था
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Right to Constitutional Remedies (Article 32): The Five High Prerogative Writs.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) & Fundamental Duties (Article 51A): Article 44 = Uniform Civil Code (UCC). DPSP (Articles 36 to 51) borrowed from Irish Constitution (1937); non-justiciable (Art 37) but fundamental in governance to establish a Welfare State
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: राज्य के नीति-निर्देशक तत्व (भाग IV) एवं मौलिक कर्तव्य (अनुच्छेद 51A): अनुच्छेद 44 = समान नागरिक संहिता (UCC)। नीति-निर्देशक तत्व (अनुच्छेद 36 से 51): आयरलैंड के संविधान से प्रेरित; गैर-न्यायसंगत किंतु शासन में मूलभूत; 'कल्याणकारी राज्य' की स्थापना का लक्ष्य
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) & Fundamental Duties (Article 51A).

factCards.canonicalStatement: The President of India: Election, Powers, Ordinance Making (Art 123) & Pardoning Power (Art 72): Presidential Ordinance = Article 123 (Governor = Art 213). Electoral College (Art 54): Elected members of Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and Legislative Assemblies of States, Delhi & Puducherry; Single Transferable Vote
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति: निर्वाचन मंडल, शक्तियां, अध्यादेश (अनुच्छेद 123) एवं क्षमादान की शक्ति (अनुच्छेद 72): राष्ट्रपति का अध्यादेश = अनुच्छेद 123 (राज्यपाल का = अनुच्छेद 213)। निर्वाचन मंडल (अनुच्छेद 54): संसद के दोनों सदनों तथा राज्यों व दिल्ली-पुडुचेरी विधानसभाओं के केवल निर्वाचित सदस्य; आनुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्व व एकल संक्रमणीय मत
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for The President of India: Election, Powers, Ordinance Making (Art 123) & Pardoning Power (Art 72).

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Vice-President of India: Qualifications, Election & Role as Rajya Sabha Chairman: Vice-President election = All MPs (Elected + Nominated) only. Second highest constitutional office (Art 63); qualifications: citizen of India, 35 years old, qualified for election as Rajya Sabha member
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति: योग्यताएं, निर्वाचन एवं राज्यसभा के पदेन सभापति के रूप में भूमिका: उपराष्ट्रपति चुनाव = संसद के सभी सांसद (निर्वाचित + मनोनीत)। देश का दूसरा सर्वोच्च संवैधानिक पद (अनुच्छेद 63); योग्यता: 35 वर्ष की आयु, राज्यसभा सदस्य बनने योग्य
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for The Vice-President of India: Qualifications, Election & Role as Rajya Sabha Chairman.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Prime Minister & Union Council of Ministers: Collective Responsibility & Art 75: Council of Ministers = Collectively responsible to Lok Sabha (Art 75(3)). Prime Minister appointed by President (Art 75(1)); real executive head (de facto) while President is nominal (de jure)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: प्रधानमंत्री एवं केंद्रीय मंत्रिपरिषद: सामूहिक उत्तरदायित्व एवं अनुच्छेद 75: मंत्रिपरिषद = सामूहिक रूप से लोकसभा के प्रति उत्तरदायी। राष्ट्रपति द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री की नियुक्ति (अनुच्छेद 75(1)); प्रधानमंत्री वास्तविक कार्यपालिका प्रमुख (डी फैक्टो) तथा राष्ट्रपति नाममात्र के प्रमुख (डी ज्यूरे)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Prime Minister & Union Council of Ministers: Collective Responsibility & Art 75.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Union Parliament: Composition, Presiding Officers & Money Bills (Article 110): Money Bill certification = Speaker of Lok Sabha (Art 110). Parliament consists of President, Rajya Sabha (Council of States, max 250), Lok Sabha (House of People, max 550)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संसद: संरचना, पीठासीन अधिकारी एवं धन विधेयक (अनुच्छेद 110): धन विधेयक का प्रमाणन = लोकसभा अध्यक्ष (अनुच्छेद 110)। संसद के तीन अंग: राष्ट्रपति, राज्यसभा (अधिकतम 250) और लोकसभा (अधिकतम 550)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Union Parliament: Composition, Presiding Officers & Money Bills (Article 110).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Parliamentary Procedures, Motions, Sessions & Key Committees (PAC & Estimates): Estimates Committee = 30 members (Lok Sabha only). Three sessions annually: Budget, Monsoon, Winter; maximum gap between sessions cannot exceed 6 months (Art 85)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: संसदीय प्रक्रियाएं, प्रस्ताव, सत्र एवं प्रमुख संसदीय समितियां (लोक लेखा व प्राक्कलन समिति): प्राक्कलन समिति = 30 सदस्य (केवल लोकसभा)। वर्ष में तीन सत्र: बजट, मानसून, शीतकालीन सत्र; दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम 6 माह से अधिक का अंतर नहीं हो सकता (अनुच्छेद 85)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Parliamentary Procedures, Motions, Sessions & Key Committees (PAC & Estimates).

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Supreme Court of India: Jurisdiction (Original, Appellate, Advisory) & Judicial Review: Inter-state federal disputes = Article 131. Inaugurated on 28 January 1950 under Article 124; current strength 34 judges (Chief Justice + 33 judges)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: भारत का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय: क्षेत्राधिकार (आरंभिक, अपीलीय, परामर्शदात्री) एवं न्यायिक समीक्षा: संघीय व अंतर्राज्यीय विवाद = अनुच्छेद 131 (आरंभिक क्षेत्राधिकार)। 28 जनवरी 1950 को उद्घाटन (अनुच्छेद 124); वर्तमान स्वीकृत संख्या 34 न्यायाधीश (1 मुख्य न्यायाधीश + 33 अन्य न्यायाधीश)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for The Supreme Court of India: Jurisdiction (Original, Appellate, Advisory) & Judicial Review.

factCards.canonicalStatement: High Courts & Subordinate Judiciary: Appointment, Transfer & Writ Jurisdiction (Article 226): High Court writ (Art 226) = Fundamental Rights + Any other legal purpose. Articles 214 to 231 cover High Courts; currently 25 High Courts in India (oldest Calcutta HC 1862; newest Andhra Pradesh HC at Amaravati 2019)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: उच्च न्यायालय एवं अधीनस्थ न्यायपालिका: नियुक्ति, स्थानांतरण एवं रिट क्षेत्राधिकार (अनुच्छेद 226): उच्च न्यायालय रिट (अनुच्छेद 226) = मूल अधिकार + अन्य कानूनी अधिकार। संविधान के अनुच्छेद 214 से 231 में उच्च न्यायालय; वर्तमान में भारत में कुल 25 उच्च न्यायालय हैं (सबसे पुराना कलकत्ता 1862; 25वां अमरावती/आंध्र प्रदेश 2019)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for High Courts & Subordinate Judiciary: Appointment, Transfer & Writ Jurisdiction (Article 226).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Evolution of Panchayati Raj: Balwant Rai Mehta, Ashok Mehta & L.M. Singhvi Committees: First Panchayat = Nagaur, Rajasthan (2 Oct 1959). Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended 3-tier Panchayati Raj system; first inaugurated at Nagaur, Rajasthan on 2 October 1959 by Nehru
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: पंचायती राज का विकास: बलवंत राय मेहता, अशोक मेहता एवं एल.एम. सिंघवी समितियां: पहली पंचायती राज व्यवस्था = नागौर, राजस्थान (2 अक्टूबर 1959)। बलवंत राय मेहता समिति (1957) ने त्रि-स्तरीय पंचायती राज की सिफारिश की; 2 अक्टूबर 1959 को राजस्थान के नागौर में नेहरू द्वारा उद्घाटन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Evolution of Panchayati Raj: Balwant Rai Mehta, Ashok Mehta & L.M. Singhvi Committees.

factCards.canonicalStatement: 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 & Eleventh Schedule (29 Functional Items): 11th Schedule (Panchayats) = 29 subjects; 12th Schedule (Municipalities) = 18. Passed in Dec 1992, enforced on 24 April 1993 (celebrated as National Panchayati Raj Day)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 73वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 1992 एवं 11वीं अनुसूची (29 कार्यात्मक विषय): 11वीं अनुसूची (पंचायत) = 29 विषय; 12वीं अनुसूची (नगर पालिका) = 18 विषय। दिसंबर 1992 में पारित, 24 अप्रैल 1993 से प्रभावी (राष्ट्रीय पंचायती राज दिवस)
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 & Eleventh Schedule (29 Functional Items).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Three-Tier Structure: Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti & Zila Parishad: Gram Sabha = All registered voters of the village. Village level: Gram Panchayat headed by Sarpanch/Pradhan; Gram Sabha is electorate comprising all registered voters
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: त्रि-स्तरीय ढांचा: ग्राम पंचायत, पंचायत समिति एवं जिला परिषद: ग्राम सभा = गांव के सभी पंजीकृत मतदाता। ग्राम स्तर: ग्राम पंचायत (प्रधान/सरपंच); ग्राम सभा में गांव के सभी पंजीकृत मतदाता सदस्य होते हैं
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Three-Tier Structure: Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti & Zila Parishad.

factCards.canonicalStatement: PESA Act 1996 (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) & Tribal Self-Rule: PESA Act 1996 = Bhuria Committee. Enacted on recommendations of Dileep Singh Bhuria Committee (1995)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: पेसा अधिनियम 1996 (अनुसूचित क्षेत्रों पर पंचायतों का विस्तार) एवं जनजातीय स्वशासन: पेसा कानून 1996 = भूरिया समिति। दिलीप सिंह भूरिया समिति (1995) की सिफारिश पर 24 दिसंबर 1996 को संसद द्वारा पारित
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for PESA Act 1996 (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) & Tribal Self-Rule.

factCards.canonicalStatement: 74th Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 & Twelfth Schedule (18 Functions): Twelfth Schedule (Municipalities) = 18 items. Enforced on 1 June 1993, inserted Part IXA ('The Municipalities', Articles 243P to 243ZG)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 74वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 1992 एवं 12वीं अनुसूची (18 नगरीय कार्य): 12वीं अनुसूची (नगरपालिकाएं) = 18 विषय। 1 जून 1993 से लागू; संविधान में भाग IXA ('नगरपालिकाएं', अनुच्छेद 243P से 243ZG) जोड़ा गया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for 74th Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 & Twelfth Schedule (18 Functions).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Urban Local Bodies: Municipal Corporations, Councils & Nagar Panchayats: First Municipal Corporation = Madras (1688). First Municipal Corporation in India established at Madras (1688), followed by Bombay and Calcutta (1726)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: शहरी स्थानीय निकायों के प्रकार: नगर निगम, नगर पालिका परिषद एवं नगर पंचायत: पहला नगर निगम = मद्रास (1688)। भारत का पहला नगर निगम 1688 में मद्रास में स्थापित हुआ, जिसके बाद बंबई और कलकत्ता (1726) में बने
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Urban Local Bodies: Municipal Corporations, Councils & Nagar Panchayats.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Urban Governance: Mayor, Municipal Commissioner & District Planning Committee (Art 243ZD): District Planning Committee = 4/5th elected members. District Planning Committee (Art 243ZD): Consolidates plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities in the district; 4/5th members elected by and from elected members of Zila Parishad and Municipalities
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: शहरी शासन व्यवस्था: महापौर, नगर निगम आयुक्त एवं जिला योजना समिति (अनुच्छेद 243ZD): जिला योजना समिति = 4/5 सदस्य निर्वाचित। जिला योजना समिति (अनुच्छेद 243ZD): जिले में पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं द्वारा तैयार योजनाओं को समेकित करती है; 4/5 सदस्य जिला पंचायत व नगर पालिकाओं के निर्वाचित सदस्यों में से चुने जाते हैं
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Urban Governance: Mayor, Municipal Commissioner & District Planning Committee (Art 243ZD).

factCards.canonicalStatement: Urban Renewal Missions: Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT & Swachh Bharat Urban: Smart Cities brain = Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC). Smart Cities Mission launched in June 2015 to develop 100 citizen-friendly, sustainable cities via Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) and Integrated Command & Control Centres (ICCC)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: शहरी पुनरुद्धार मिशन: स्मार्ट सिटीज मिशन, अमृत (AMRUT) एवं स्वच्छ भारत मिशन (नगरीय): स्मार्ट सिटी का नियंत्रण तंत्र = ICCC। स्मार्ट सिटीज मिशन (जून 2015): 100 शहरों को एसपीवी (SPV) और एकीकृत कमान एवं नियंत्रण केंद्रों (ICCC) के जरिए आधुनिक बनाना
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Urban Renewal Missions: Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT & Swachh Bharat Urban.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Administration of Union Territories: Articles 239 to 241 & Lieutenant Governors: Only UT with exclusive High Court = Delhi (1966). Part VIII of Constitution (Articles 239 to 241); administered directly by President through an Administrator or Lieutenant Governor (LG)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों का प्रशासन: अनुच्छेद 239 से 241 एवं उपराज्यपाल (LG): एकमात्र यूटी जिसका अपना हाईकोर्ट है = दिल्ली (1966)। संविधान का भाग VIII (अनुच्छेद 239 से 241); राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नियुक्त प्रशासक या उपराज्यपाल (LG) के माध्यम से प्रत्यक्ष प्रशासन
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Administration of Union Territories: Articles 239 to 241 & Lieutenant Governors.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Special Constitutional Provisions for Delhi: Article 239AA & NCT Administration: Delhi Assembly exclusions = Public Order, Police, Land (Entries 1, 2, 18). Inserted by 69th Constitutional Amendment Act 1991 (based on S. Balakrishnan Committee)
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: दिल्ली हेतु विशेष संवैधानिक प्रावधान: अनुच्छेद 239AA एवं राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र प्रशासन: दिल्ली विधानसभा के अपवर्जित विषय = लोक व्यवस्था, पुलिस और भूमि। 69वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 1991 (एस. बालकृष्णन समिति की रिपोर्ट पर आधारित) द्वारा अनुच्छेद 239AA जोड़ा गया
factCards.evidence: Verified across standard competitive examination syllabi (UPSC, State PSC, SSC) for Special Constitutional Provisions for Delhi: Article 239AA & NCT Administration.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Fifth Schedule Areas: Tribal Advisory Councils & Governor's Legislative Powers: Declare Scheduled Area = President of India. Article 244(1) applies to administration of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in 10 states (excluding Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram)
